summary: This Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reports ordinary ATM (at-the-market) equity issuances by LQR House Inc. under a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. On June 30, 2026, the company sold 57,100,000 shares at $0.1063/share, raising ~$6.07M; on July 1, 2026, it sold 19,250,000 shares at $0.0539/share, raising ~$1.04M. Outstanding shares increased from 21,533,546 to 97,883,546, resulting in massive dilution (355%). The filing is a routine disclosure of at-the-market stock sales, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor appointment, merger agreement, restructuring plan, going-private transaction, or strategic review is mentioned. It is a routine capital raising activity.
